title: EntityTypeDef
description: Per-entity-type definition loaded from the content YAML.

build_cost.description: Resources required to create one instance of this entity type.

builds.description: Units this entity type can produce.

collector.description: M8: Optional collection profile for collector-capable entities.

combat.description:
Optional autonomous-combat profile. When present, the server acquires
nearby hostile entities and drives the unit according to its strategy.

combat_targetable.description:
Whether autonomous combat may select this entity type as a target.
Defaults to false so scenery and resource entities are safe by default.

fog_memory.description: Client behavior when this entity leaves sensor coverage.

hull_radius.description:
Physical hull radius used by contact attacks. This is deliberately
separate from visual scale and movement-order stop radius.

maintenance_cost_per_minute.description: Per-resource upkeep charged to the entity owner, in units per minute.

radiation_shielding.description: Per-radiation-type shielding modifiers for this entity type.

radiation_sources.description: Environmental hazard emitters attached to this entity type.

refinery.description: M8: Optional refinery/processor profile for transport deposits.

resource_node.description: M8: Optional resource-node profile for collectible source entities.

sensor.description: Optional area sensor. Its operating costs are charged continuously.

suppress_hover.description: Whether the client should suppress hover UI for this entity type.

visibility_range.description: Target-side detection range used to extend a player's sensor coverage.

visual_scale.description: Client-only multiplier for the entity's rendered size.

z_index.description: Draw order within the world layer. Higher values render in front.

contact_tolerance.description: Extra slack beyond two touching hulls for a dismantle attack.

range.description: Maximum center-to-center range for a ranged weapon.

BuildOptionDef.description: One content-defined production option available to a builder.

spend_rates.description: Resource conversion rates. A missing required resource defaults to 1/s.

CollectionMode.description: M8: Collection mode for a resource source.

carry_capacity.description: Max carried amount for transport mode before deposit run.

collects.description: Resource type ids this collector can gather.

deposit_entity_types.description:
Optional allowed refinery entity type ids for transport deposits.
Empty means any refinery that accepts the resource.

proximity_rate_per_second.description: Units/second gathered in proximity mode while in effective band.

transport_rate_per_second.description: Units/second gathered in transport mode while in gather band.

CombatDef.description:
Data needed for server-authoritative autonomous combat.

Timings are ticks, rather than seconds, so a combat replay is a pure
function of the content version and tick stream.

acquisition_range.description: Maximum distance at which this unit acquires a hostile target.

attacks.description: Weapons available to this entity. Their stable IDs also key cooldowns.

on_near_enemy_strategy.description: How this unit responds after acquiring a nearby hostile.

NearEnemyStrategy.description: Autonomous movement response to a nearby hostile entity.

oneOf.description: Move into weapon range, then fire. This preserves existing NPC behavior.
Move directly away from the nearest hostile without firing.
Do not move; fire only if the hostile is already in weapon range.

RadiationShieldingDef.description: Per-radiation-type shielding profile for an entity type.

damage_multiplier.description: Multiplies incoming damage after distance adjustment.

distance_offset.description: Acts like extra standoff distance for hazard evaluation.

RadiationSourceDef.description: Environmental radiation emitted by an entity type.

full_damage_distance_border_color.description: Hex color for the full-damage-distance range outline.

full_damage_distance_fill_color.description: Hex color for the full-damage-distance range fill.

max_effective_distance_border_color.description: Hex color for the max-effective-distance range outline.

max_effective_distance_fill_color.description: Hex color for the max-effective-distance range fill.

min_effective_distance_border_color.description: Hex color for the min-effective-distance range outline.

min_effective_distance_fill_color.description: Hex color for the min-effective-distance range fill.

accepts.description: Resource type ids this structure accepts for deposit.

cost_per_min.description: Resource costs while actively repairing, in units per minute.

efficiency.description: Health restored per total resource unit consumed.

range.description: Maximum center-to-center repair distance in world units.

ResourceNodeDef.description: M8: Resource source profile for entity types that can be gathered from.

SensorDef.description: Content-defined sensor available to any entity type.

cost_per_minute.description: Per-resource operating cost, in units per minute.

range.description: Circular detection radius in world units.
